Appraisal Dimension

  • CURIE: gmeow:AppraisalDimension
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AppraisalDimension
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/affect
  • Box roles: TBox role (What is this?)

A dimensional axis of affective appraisal — an OPEN vocabulary seeded with the PAD triad: valence (pleasant ↔ unpleasant), arousal (activated ↔ calm), dominance (in control ↔ controlled).

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:AppraisalDimension as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
